title: Analyticity and tautness of smooth Dupin hypersurfaces
summary: We prove that smooth immersed Dupin submanifolds of Euclidean space are locally Nash in arbitrary codimension and that every compact embedded Dupin submanifold is taut. These conclusions follow from our hypersurface results by the tube construction. For hypersurfaces, we require the Dupin condition only where the principal multiplicities are locally constant. No local finiteness assumption on this regular locus, or regularity assumption on its complement, is required. The proof combines a dimension-dependent degree bound on proper Dupin pieces with a continuation argument using finite jets…
